verdict.rationale: Smithery's Uplink feature is documented as exposing an MCP server running on any machine as a regular Smithery connection, explicitly for testing before publishing or running a private tool 'without hosting it'. That matches the story of bridging a local server as a managed remote connection without deploying it. Missing for 10: details on the bridging mechanism (tunnel setup, auth, reconnection and persistence behavior) and any independent or hands-on corroboration that Uplink works as described.
